title: CHFR drives gastric cancer stemness and hepatic metastasis by suppressing ITCH-mediated ubiquitination and degradation of OCT4.
authors: Dai, Mugen; Wang, Jianbo; Xu, Qing; Shao, Yixiu; Wang, Han; Wu, Xiaomeng; Pan, Jundi; Ye, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CHFR通过抑制ITCH介导的OCT4泛素化降解促进胃癌干性和肝转移，虽涉及OCT4转录因子和分子对接预测蛋白互作，但核心是泛素化信号通路而非TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以湿实验为主，仅少量计算辅助，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer (GC) is one of the most lethal malignancies worldwide, and hepatic metastasis is a major cause of its poor clinical prognosis. The stemness regulator octamer-binding transcription factor 4 (OCT4) drives the migration, invasion and metastasis of GC cells. As a RING-type E3 ubiquitin ligase, Checkpoint with Forkhead-associated and RING finger domains (CHFR) has been identified as a key promoter of metastasis in advanced GC. However, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying CHFR-mediated modulation of GC metastasis remain unclear. RESULTS: This study systematically explored the biological functions and molecular mechanism of CHFR in GC via public data analysis, in vitro cell experiments and in vivo hepatic metastasis models. Functional assays revealed that CHFR overexpression enhanced the stemness and metastatic capacity of GC cells but inhibited cell proliferation. Mechanistically, CHFR stabilized OCT4 protein by blocking itchy E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase (ITCH)-mediated ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of OCT4. Molecular docking predicted a direct interaction between CHFR and ITCH, and site mutation studies showed that their binding interface was essential for CHFR-induced OCT4 stabilization. DynaMut2 and FoldX mutagenesis confirmed Tyr530 (CHFR) and Thr222 (ITCH) as critical interfacial residues, whose alanine substitution weakened complex binding. Biochemical Co-IP ubiquitination assays verified CHFR targets ITCH for proteasomal degradation to suppress ITCH-dependent OCT4 breakdown. OCT4 knockdown rescue experiments further validated OCT4 as the essential downstream mediator of CHFR-induced glycolytic reprogramming, stemness and invasion in GC cells. Importantly, in vivo xenograft assays demonstrated that CHFR overexpression significantly promoted GC liver metastasis, whereas simultaneous overexpression of CHFR and ITCH reversed this metastatic phenotype. CONCLUSION: CHFR enhances the stemness and metastatic progression of advanced GC cells by antagonizing ITCH-dependent OCT4 degradation, highlighting the CHFR/ITCH/OCT4 axis as a therapeutic target for GC treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：胃癌（GC）是全球最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，肝转移是其临床预后不良的主要原因。干性调控因子八聚体结合转录因子4（OCT4）驱动GC细胞的迁移、侵袭和转移。作为一种RING型E3泛素连接酶，具有Forkhead相关和RING指结构域的检查点蛋白（CHFR）已被确定为晚期GC转移的关键促进因子。然而，CHFR介导GC转移调控的精确分子机制仍不清楚。结果：本研究通过公共数据分析、体外细胞实验和体内肝转移模型，系统探讨了CHFR在GC中的生物学功能和分子机制。功能实验表明，CHFR过表达增强了GC细胞的干性和转移能力，但抑制了细胞增殖。机制上，CHFR通过阻断痒E3泛素蛋白连接酶（ITCH）介导的OCT4泛素化和蛋白酶体降解来稳定OCT4蛋白。分子对接预测了CHFR与ITCH之间的直接相互作用，位点突变研究表明它们的结合界面对于CHFR诱导的OCT4稳定化至关重要。DynaMut2和FoldX突变分析确认Tyr530（CHFR）和Thr222（ITCH）为关键界面残基，其丙氨酸替换削弱了复合物结合。生化Co-IP泛素化实验验证了CHFR靶向ITCH进行蛋白酶体降解，从而抑制ITCH依赖的OCT4分解。OCT4敲低拯救实验进一步验证了OCT4是CHFR诱导的GC细胞糖酵解重编程、干性和侵袭的关键下游介质。重要的是，体内异种移植实验表明，CHFR过表达显著促进了GC肝转移，而CHFR和ITCH的同时过表达逆转了这种转移表型。结论：CHFR通过拮抗ITCH依赖的OCT4降解来增强晚期GC细胞的干性和转移进展，突出CHFR/ITCH/OCT4轴作为GC治疗的治疗靶点。
